title: From batch 1's drives: plugin list answers nothing on the keg, and two shim remedies say reinstall when no reinstall rewrites the pointer
body:
From dc's batch 1 drives, not fixed:

- `intent plugin list` on the keg answers `No plugins found.` while the dev tree lists `agents` and `claude`: `plugins.rs` reads `plugin.json` through a `read_dir` behind a function return, which no source scan follows, and `intent/plugins/agents/plugin.json` still does not ship.
- The shim's other two remedies (a pointer resolving to a non-install; an install missing its gate) still say "reinstall Intent", which rewrites no pointer.

Found by hv's estate-wide doc audit of 2026-09-11 (the audit's orders are in `intent/history/20260911-doc-audit.md`), where it is described as built. Carried in `intent/wip.md` as an unruled defect until 2026-09-13, when that file was leaned and every open defect became an issue. Not worked until hv rules it; a ruled one gets a lane.


CLOSED 2026-09-14 (dc), both:
- The keg ships `intent/plugins/agents/plugin.json`: `bin/devbin macos` carries it in SUPPORT_PATHS. Judged on a keg tarball built both ways (scratchpad batch/judge-0340-tar.txt, 16:16:07Z): before, the agents manifest was not carried; after, it is, and `intent plugin list` on the keg lists `agents`.
- Both "reinstall Intent" remedies in `lib/templates/hooks/pre-commit-shim.sh` (a pointer naming a non-install; an install missing its gate) now name `intent bootstrap`, which rewrites the pointer. Driven for the non-install pointer, before and after (batch/judge-0340.txt): "reinstall Intent so the pointer is rewritten" became "run `intent bootstrap` from the Intent install this pointer should name -- it rewrites the pointer -- then re-commit". The missing-gate remedy is the same text change and was read, not driven.
